answer: A fixed 40,000-credit pool splits equally among verified identities; fakes cannot grow it. Each identity files one key-bound claim on the umber ledger for one fresh voyage, burning a 15-credit fee. Each epoch lantern auditors sample claims; workless claims are rejected, fees burned. 2,000 honest identities take 20, net 5. 1,000 fakes burn 15,000 for zero share. A rented voyage fails, bound to its key. Honest filing costs 15 and keeps its share.
